regions.name: TransitionalMass
regions.rationale: Light cubes may behave differently when slipping when moving across the wall.

regions.name: HighFrictionWallTraverse
regions.rationale: High friction could generate pitching moment that tips the cube when crossing the wall.

regions.name: LargeDelayedGripper
regions.rationale: Long actuation latency can cause gripper close after the wall is passed.

regions.name: NoisyMisplacedOffset
regions.rationale: High sensor noise combined with offset can misestimate position needed to clear the wall.

regions.name: LargeSmallishCube
regions.rationale: Large but not too large cubes may slip at the wall when friction is medium.

regions.name: NarrowMisplacedLowNoise
regions.rationale: Small positional errors with low noise might slip when the cube is offset toward the wall edge.
